story.title: Finance Module - Funding Source Tracking for Donor Accountability
story.summary: Enable Finance Managers to track transactions against specific funding sources (donors, grants) to ensure accountability and generate donor-specific reports. This involves creating a funding sources management UI, linking transactions to these sources, validating spending against allocated amounts, and generating PDF reports.
story.i_want: to track income and expenses against specific funding sources and generate donor reports
story.so_that: I can ensure we are spending funds according to donor restrictions and provide accurate accountability reports.

criterion.details: - Admin can create, read, update, and delete funding sources. - Required fields: Name, Type (Grant, Donation, etc.), Amount Allocated, Date Received. - Optional fields: Donor Name, Start/End Dates, Restrictions, Status. - System tracks 'Current Balance' automatically based on transactions.

- When recording an Income, user can select a Funding Source (increasing balance). - When recording an Expense, user can select a Funding Source (decreasing balance). - UI shows current balance of the selected source.
- View details of a specific funding source. - List all transactions associated with this source (paginated, sortable). - Show progress bar of Spent vs. Allocated.
- "Funding Overview" widget on Finance Dashboard. - Shows top 5 active funding sources with their remaining balances.
- If an expense exceeds the funding source's remaining balance, show a Warning Dialog. - Allow user to cancel or proceed (with explicit confirmation). - Do not strictly block, but warn.

- Button to "Export Report" on Funding Source Detail page. - Generates a PDF including: Source Details, Summary (Allocated, Spent, Remaining), and Transaction List. - Uses client-side generation (jspdf).

file.description: Schema definition script. Needs update to match Funding Source fields in Story 2.4.
Finance Store. Contains logic for fetching transactions and updating balances. Needs new actions for Funding Source CRUD and Reporting.
Transaction Form. Needs validation logic for overspending warning.

constraint.description: RBAC: Only 'Finance Managers' and 'Admins' can manage Funding Sources. 'Finance Viewers' can only view.
PDF generation must happen client-side to support offline capability (eventually) and reduce server load.
Schema Update: The existing schema script must be updated to include all fields defined in Story 2.4 (donor_name, dates, status, etc.).
